description: Update information about a specific Potential Change Order (PCO).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the Potential Change Order.

id.description: Unique identifier for this Potential Change Order. Use as the {id} path parameter to retrieve, update, or delete it.

accounting_method.description: How the change order is priced: "amount" for a lump-sum total or "unit" for quantity-times-unit-cost line items.

change_order_change_reason_id.description: ID of the change reason assigned to this PCO, if change reasons are enabled for the project.

change_order_request_id.description: ID of the Change Order Request (COR) this PCO belongs to, on multi-tier contract configurations.

commitment_change_event_id.description: ID of the commitment Change Event this PCO was generated from. Set when the contract is a commitment.

contract_id.description: ID of the contract (prime or commitment) this PCO belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the PCO was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the PCO was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null for active PCOs.

description.description: Free-text description of the scope of this change order.

due_date.description: Date by which the change order is due, in ISO 8601 format.

field_change.description: True when this change order originated as a field change (a change identified in the field rather than through the office workflow).

grand_total.description: Total value of the change order including markup, as a decimal string.

invoiced_date.description: Date the change order was invoiced (YYYY-MM-DD).

id.description: Unique identifier for this change order line item.

position.description: Ordering position of this line item within the change order.

description.description: Free-text description of the work or item this line covers.

quantity.description: Number of units for this line item, in the given unit of measure.

uom.description: Unit of measure for the quantity (a unit from the company's Units of Measure list).

total_amount.description: Total amount for this line item, as a decimal string.

extended_amount.description: Line item amount after applied markup, as a decimal string.

cost_code_id.description: ID of the Cost Code this line item is charged against.

tax_code_id.description: ID of the Tax Code applied to this line item, if any.

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit, as a decimal. Multiplied by quantity to compute the line item amount.

line_items_extended_total.description: Sum of all line item extended amounts (after markup), as a decimal string.

line_items_total.description: Sum of all line item amounts (before markup), as a decimal string.

location_id.description: ID of the project location this change order is associated with.

number.description: Human-readable change order number, unique within the contract.

origin_data.description: Free-form metadata from an external system, stored to correlate this PCO with its source record.

origin_id.description: Identifier of this PCO in the external system it was imported from. Use to match records during integrations.

paid.description: True when the change order has been marked as paid.

paid_date.description: Date the change order was paid (YYYY-MM-DD).

position.description: Ordering position of this PCO within its contract.

prime_change_event_id.description: ID of the prime contract Change Event this PCO was generated from. Set when the contract is a prime contract.

private.description: If true, visible to admins only; otherwise visible to those with access to the parent contract.

reason.description: Reason the change order was raised.

reference.description: Free-text reference linking this PCO to a related record (for example, a change event).

request_for_quote_id.description: ID of the Request for Quote (RFQ) this PCO is associated with, if any.

reviewed_at.description: Timestamp when the change order was reviewed, in ISO 8601 format. Null if not yet reviewed.

revision.description: Revision number of the change order, incremented on each revision.

schedule_impact_amount.description: Estimated impact of this change order on the project schedule, in days.

status.description: Workflow status of the change order.

title.description: Short title summarizing the change order.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the PCO was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

void.description: True when the change order has been voided.

data_type.description: Data type of the Custom Field Definition

value.description: The value of the custom field

variant.description: The variant of the Custom Field Definition (e.g. `phone_number`). Present only when the definition has an associated variant.

data_type.description: Data type of the Custom Field Definition

value.description: The value of the custom field

data_type.description: Data type of the Custom Field Definition

value.description: The value of the custom field

data_type.description: Data type of the Custom Field Definition

variant.description: The variant of the Custom Field Definition (e.g. `project_directory`). Present only when the definition has an associated variant.

data_type.description: Data type of the Custom Field Definition

400.description: Can not update change order due to errors.

403.description: User does not have right permissions.

contract_id.description: ID of the contract (prime or commitment) this change order belongs to.

change_order_request_id.description: ID of the Change Order Request (COR) this PCO belongs to. Used on multi-tier contract configurations to group the PCO under a request.

change_order_package_id.description: ID of the Change Order Package the PCO's Change Order Request is assigned to. Applies to two-tier contract configurations.

commitment_change_event_id.description: ID of the commitment Change Event this PCO was generated from. Set when the contract is a commitment.

description.description: Free-text description of the scope of this change order.

due_date.description: Date by which the change order is due, in ISO 8601 format.

invoiced_date.description: Date the change order was invoiced (YYYY-MM-DD).

number.description: Human-readable change order number, unique within the contract.

origin_data.description: Free-form metadata from an external system, stored to correlate this PCO with its source record.

origin_id.description: Identifier of this PCO in the external system it was imported from. Use to match records during integrations.

paid_date.description: Date the change order was paid (YYYY-MM-DD).

prime_change_event_id.description: ID of the prime contract Change Event this PCO was generated from. Set when the contract is a prime contract.

schedule_impact_amount.description: Estimated impact of this change order on the project schedule, in days.

status.description: Workflow status of the change order. Ignored on projects where the tool is configured for single-tier change orders.

title.description: Short title summarizing the change order.

currency_exchange_rate.description: Exchange rate used to convert from the change order's currency to the project's currency. Accepted only on projects where multicurrency conversion is available.
